title: Independent static audit of Stark runtime adapter candidate
scope: Read-only frozen JSON, raw source hashes and application source text. No app edits, runtime imports, tests, builds, browser, network research or Codex task. Only audit outputs written.

findings.finding: This candidate contains no runtime buyer-proposal binding. Full expected identity, Fact, availability and source snapshots, required visible conditions, stale/future-date/source-drift mutation suppression and UI behavior remain to be independently verified after authorized binding.

Both existing Stark family rows in each market/census file still have accepting_orders/new_stock_listed; EX still has road_legal_enduro. Apply the bounded correction by existing family ID before publishing a consistent integrated catalogue. Do not append duplicate family rows or interpret four configurations as physical units.

All 21 sources are transported as context, including opposite-family material and excluded SKOLL. This is explicit and does not weaken source flags. The later binder must preserve narrow fact/availability dependencies; config.sourceIds must never be copied wholesale into current-claim guards. Family observations must remain family-labeled, especially SM demonstrations stored in the full provenance object.
